method: tenseal.sealapi (Microsoft SEAL C++ API bindings): CoeffModulus.MaxBitCount() against the Homomorphic Encryption Security Standard tables, cross-checked by constructing a SEALContext with security-level enforcement and reading parameters_set().
conclusion: N=16384, 400-bit chain satisfies TC128 (ceiling 438 bits) but not TC192 -- lambda=128 is confirmed, not merely asserted.
